snapshot.text: Tax-funded public system run through four Regional Health Authorities, with a high burden of non-communicable diseases. The ministry is investing in new hospitals and tightening accountability of health bodies.

priorities.title: Healthcare workforce strategy
priorities.text: A sector-wide healthcare workforce strategy and better conditions for medical interns.

priorities.title: Accountability of health bodies
priorities.text: An accountability framework and tighter financial operations in the public health sector.

priorities.title: NCDs and sugar
priorities.text: The minister urges beverage manufacturers to cut sugar content.
